# BCFTOOLS_SORT

Sort any valid VCF with bcftools, compress it, and create a Tabix index. The output uses a fixed `.sv.vcf.gz` suffix.

Input: `calls` record with `id` (String) and `vcf` (Path). Use an ID suitable for a filename.

Output: record with the same `id`, sorted and compressed `vcf` (`<id>.sv.vcf.gz`), and `tbi` index (`<id>.sv.vcf.gz.tbi`).

nextflow.enable.types = true

record RawCalls {
    id: String
    vcf: Path
}

process BCFTOOLS_SORT {
    container 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/bcftools_htslib:5fb0d107a063e6c9'

    input:
    calls: RawCalls

    output:
    record(
        id: calls.id,
        vcf: file("${calls.id}.sv.vcf.gz"),
        tbi: file("${calls.id}.sv.vcf.gz.tbi"),
    )

    script:
    """
    bcftools sort -O z -o ${calls.id}.sv.vcf.gz ${calls.vcf}
    tabix -p vcf ${calls.id}.sv.vcf.gz
    """
}

kind: Process
description: Sort, compress, and index a VCF.
keywords:
- structural variants
- vcf
- sort
license: MIT
authors:
- Seqera Services
tools:
- bcftools:
    description: VCF sorting and compression.
    documentation: https://samtools.github.io/bcftools/bcftools.html
- tabix:
    description: Indexing of compressed VCF files.
    documentation: https://www.htslib.org/doc/tabix.html
input:
- name: calls
  type: record
  description: Record with id (String) and vcf (Path).
output:
- - name: id
    type: string
    description: Input ID.
  - name: vcf
    type: file
    description: Sorted and compressed VCF (<id>.sv.vcf.gz).
  - name: tbi
    type: file
    description: Tabix index for the VCF.
